summary: upperMeasure(F, l) = upperMeasure(F, l+1) ∗ θ^F_l and Fubini.

steps.lean: have I := hk.integrable_upperMeasure l g y
steps.claim: I: x ↦ k(xg, xy) is integrable for upperMeasure(F, l).
Unfold: upperMeasure(F, l) = upperMeasure(F, l+1) ∗ θ^F_l and k((x·σ)g, (x·σ)y) = k(x(σg), x(σy)).
J_T: (x, σ) ↦ k(xσg, xσy) is integrable for the product measure upperMeasure(F, l+1) × θ^F_l.

steps.lean: use J.integral_prod_right, integral_mconv I ▸ integral_integral_swap J
steps.claim: Hence σ ↦ ∫ k(xσg, xσy) dupperMeasure(F, l+1)(x) = upperPairing(F, l+1, k, σg, σy) is θ^F_l-integrable, and the integral over the convolution is the iterated integral (Fubini).
